name: Crumbl Chocolate Chip Cookies
desc: Giant, thick bakery-style chocolate chip cookies made with milk chocolate chips and a little cornstarch.

source.title: Crumbl Chocolate Chip Cookie Recipe (Copycat)
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list including the high-altitude notes and the 1 1/2 bags of 11.5 oz Ghirardelli milk chocolate chips, and the same pinch-and-stack shaping at 375°F.

ingredients.raw: 1 cup (2 sticks) salted or unsalted butter, room temperature
1 1/4 cups packed light brown sugar (1 cup at high altitude)
3 cups unbleached all-purpose flour (add 2 tbsp at high altitude)
1 1/4 tsp kosher salt (add 1/4 tsp if using unsalted butter)
ingredients.note: add 1/4 tsp if using unsalted butter

ingredients.raw: 2-3 cups milk chocolate chips (about 1 1/2 bags of 11.5 oz Ghirardelli)

steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F with a rack in the middle. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Beat the butter with a stand mixer until light and fluffy, about 1 minute. Add both sugars and beat until creamy, 3-5 minutes, scraping the bowl halfway.
Add the eggs one at a time on medium speed, about 1 minute each, then the vanilla. Scrape the bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the flour, cornstarch, baking soda and salt.
With the mixer on low, add the flour mixture a little at a time, mixing only until no flour streaks remain.

Scoop a heaping 1/3 cup of dough (about 117 g). Pull it in half, flip the top half over, and stack it on the bottom half jagged side up. Place 2-3 inches apart. If the dough is very soft, chill the balls 10-20 minutes.
Bake 10-12 minutes, until the edges are barely golden and the centers are slightly firm (14-15 minutes for a less gooey cookie). Cool on the pan 10 minutes, then move to a wire rack.
